task_completion.description: The agent creates the project directory and the conditions.csv file with the required columns.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or terminal showing /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/ttc_task/ containing conditions.csv, or the CSV file open in an editor showing 'speed', 'start_pos', and 'direction' columns.

task_completion.description: The agent attempts to download or save the background image to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A browser window, terminal command (wget/curl), or file explorer showing road_bg.jpg in the ttc_task folder.

task_completion.description: The agent opens PsychoPy Builder and begins constructing the experiment.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PsychoPy Builder GUI is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: The agent adds an image component (background), a polygon component (circular vehicle), and a rectangular occluder.

task_completion.description: The agent sets the vehicle's position using a time-based formula with 'speed' and 'start_pos' variables and adds a keyboard component.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The properties window for the circular vehicle shows a formula in the 'Position' field (e.g., involving $t, speed, start_pos). A keyboard component named 'key_resp' or similar is visible in the routine with 'space' as an allowed key.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the experiment as ttc_task.psyexp and compiles it to a Python script.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PsychoPy window title shows 'ttc_task.psyexp' and the agent clicks the 'Compile Script' button (paper icon), resulting in a new .py tab or file appearing.

integrity.description: The agent uses the PsychoPy Builder GUI to design the experiment rather than just writing a Python script manually.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent clicking buttons and typing into property fields within the PsychoPy Builder interface.

integrity.description: The agent creates the conditions.csv file with actual data rows.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent typing data into a spreadsheet or text editor for the CSV file, containing at least three rows.

integrity.description: The agent uses the variables from the conditions file in the component properties.
integrity.visual_evidence: The PsychoPy component property fields contain variable names (e.g., $speed) rather than static numbers.
